series: experimental 18 patches incl. selector hardening (0a2ceb37) and query-count dispatch (e79d50c0)
root_cause: stage18b always-FA routed the 8-token DFlash verify step through packed_attention_flash, which materializes the entire KV (33MiB chunks, Python loop, per-layer per-step). Decode fell to 6.4-6.8 tok/s at any depth.
fix: dispatch on query count: >8 queries -> FA prefill path; <=8 -> fused split kernel (no materialization)

measurements_live.note: client tok/s counts content deltas; engine counts all generated tokens incl. tool/hidden

selector_hardening: ported syv-ai kvarn-v2-runner degenerate-score fixes (NaN->-1e30, index clamp, zeros-init buffers); accept on natural text still 2-3 vs syv 3.2-3.8 (their draft-vocab tuning not ported)
remaining_gap_vs_syv: step ~100ms eager vs their ~21-26ms captured; graphs blocked because per-step Python pool bookkeeping (begin_write/finish_attention) does not replay; unlocking requires moving decode KV writes into graph-replayable kernels (Huawei fused decode + kernel-side sealing)
baseline_restored: n/a - stage19b is the live deployment
